errors.evidence: The chart is a stacked bar chart, not a line chart as stated.
The word "труда" (labor/work) is an incorrect and ambiguous translation of what the chart represents, which is "оборот" (turnover), as indicated in the original paper's figure caption.
The chart legend shows seven different categories, not four. The number of components in each stacked bar also varies by year.
The names for two categories are incorrectly transcribed. They should be „Компенсаторни инструменти“ and „Сегмент на държавни ценни книжа“.

The description omits two major categories from the legend: "Акции (без АДСИЦ)" (the blue component) and "Акции на АДСИЦ" (the dark red component), which constitute a large portion of the turnover in most years.
The highest bar corresponds to the year 2013, reaching approximately 1520 million BGN. The bar for 2019 is actually the lowest on the chart.

errors.text_span: воден от „Акции и дялове на колективни инвестиционни продукти“
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the 2012 turnover was led by "Акции и дялове на колективни инвестиционни продукти". The chart clearly shows the largest component for 2012 is "Акции (без АДСИЦ)" (the blue section).

The bar for 2017 is not low; at approximately 710 million BGN, it is one of the higher bars on the chart, taller than those for 2012, 2015, 2016, 2018, 2019, and 2020. Classifying it as low is factually incorrect.
